chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When the death of a man is announced to his family, or they are informed that he has divorced her, so she observes the waiting period, then she remarries, and her husband comes afterwards, then the first [husband] is more rightful with her than this latter one, whether he entered with her or did not enter with her, and for her is the dower from the latter with what he made permissible of her private part.
He (peace be upon him) said: And it is not for the latter one that he remarries her, ever.

key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: He entered with her (consummated the marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman remarries after hearing her husband died or divorced her, but he returns alive?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the ruling of *iddah* in cases of erroneous news (*khabar*), where a woman remarries based on the report of her husband's death or divorce. It clarifies that the first husband retains priority (*ahna*) upon return, regardless of consummation, while the second husband retains the dower (*mahr*) for the period he lawfully enjoyed her. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that the validity of the second marriage is contingent on the truth of the initial report, distinguishing it from cases of actual death or final divorce.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

When the obituary of the man comes to his wife, or she is informed that he has divorced her, so she observes the waiting period, then she remarries. So her husband comes over afterwards, so he is more rightful with her than this later one, whether he has copulated with her or not copulated with her, and for her is the later of the dowers with what she had allowed from her relief’.
And it is not for the later one that he remarries her, ever’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If a woman receives news of the death of her husband or she is informed about her being divorced by her husband and she counts her waiting period. Thereafter marries then her previous husband comes. The first one is more rightful than the second one, regardless, he (the second) has gone to bed with her or not, but she can demand mahr (dower) from the second one because of his going to bed with her and the second one can thereafter never lawfully marry her again.”’ Abu al-‘Abbas al-Razzaz, Muhammad ibn Ja‘far has narrated from abu Ayyub ibn Nuh. Abu Ali al- Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Tsma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from all from Safwan from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah from abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a similar Hadith.
